name: Deploy Site

  push:
    branches:

  pages: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout

          python scripts/extract-images.py

      - name: Build Slides
        run: |
          bash scripts/build-slides.sh

      - name: Build Pages
        run: |
          python scripts/build-pages.py

      - name: Build Gallery
        run: |
          python scripts/build-gallery.py

      - name: Build PDFs
        run: |
          python scripts/build-pdfs.py

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: '_site'

  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}

    needs: build
